title: Platform
unavailable.title: Not available here
unavailable.body: Platform readiness is shown for a connected workspace.
forbidden: Only owners and administrators of this workspace can see platform readiness.
overall.title: Is the platform ready?
overall.ok: Everything this server runs is working, and backups meet the recovery targets.
overall.warning: Something needs attention soon. See the parts marked below.
overall.failing: Something is not working. See the parts marked below for what to do.
overall.not_configured: Nothing is set up to check yet.
overall.no_data: Some parts have not reported yet.
targets.title: Recovery targets
targets.eyebrow: How much could be lost, and how fast it comes back
targets.rpoValue: The newest good copy is {minutes} minutes old.
targets.rpoNone: No backup or snapshot has been reported yet.
targets.rpoHelp: Turn on hourly snapshots (the snapshots setting in the pilot's config.json), then check the services log for snapshot_failed.
targets.rto: Back up and running within {minutes} minutes
targets.rtoValue: The last restore drill took {minutes} minutes, {days, plural, one {# day ago} two {# days ago} other {# days ago}}.
targets.rtoNone: No restore drill has been reported yet.
targets.rtoHelp: Run a restore drill (backup.mjs verify) on a recent snapshot at least every {days} days. If it failed, its code is listed under Backups.
about.database: Stores every learner record. Its schema must match this version of Course Core.
about.temporal: Runs AI supervision in the background. The worker reaches this server every few seconds while it runs.
about.sandbox: Runs learners' code answers in isolation. Needed only for courses with code checks.
about.collector: Sends traces and metrics to your collector. Only counts and codes, never learner text.
about.version: What this server runs, and whether the runtime is a supported one.
about.backups: The latest snapshot, stopped backup and restore drill reported by the backup tool.
fix.database: Restart the server so it applies its migrations, or run the upgrade script. If the version is below 17, upgrade PostgreSQL.
fix.temporal: Check that the worker and dispatcher are running (pilot.mjs status) and that Temporal started. Held-back events are listed on the Supervision page.
fix.sandbox: Start Docker and check that the pinned sandbox image is present, then restart the server.
fix.sandboxSlow: In the last hour Docker was too slow to start the sandbox, so some code answers were not run. Learners were asked to send them again, and those tries did not count. If this keeps happening, the server is overloaded or its disk is slow: check the load, or move Docker to faster storage.
fix.collector: Some traces were dropped. Check that the collector is reachable and not overloaded.
fix.version: Run Course Core on Node 26 and PostgreSQL 17 or later.
fix.backups: See the recovery targets above. A failed run is listed here with its code.
fact.slowStarts: Code answers not run: slow start
dropped: {full} because the queue was full, {failed} because sending failed
targets.encryptionNone: No snapshot or backup reported yet.
targets.encryptionOff: The newest copy is not encrypted.
targets.encryptionHelp: Encryption is optional. Backups work without it, but anyone who gets a copy of an unencrypted backup can read every learner's data. To turn it on, install age on the server, put an age public key in the pilot's configuration as the backup recipient, and keep the private key somewhere else (see the pilot guide, "Encrypting backups with age").
